messages.text:
A possible wrong direction would be copying the Rust test snapshots as expected output; that would make validation fixed instead of oracle-based.

I’m instead going to build the Python CLI plus a generator that creates real filesystem states, runs both binaries, and compares exit code/stdout/stderr live.
